program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define colors (sort (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 8)))) (grid-colors g)) <))
    (define (path-cells start goal)
      (define parent (make-hash))
      (define visited (mutable-set))
      (define queue (list (cons (first start) (second start))))
      (define goal-key (cons (first goal) (second goal)))
      (define found #f)
      (set-add! visited (first queue))
      (let bfs ([step 0])
        (unless (or found (empty? queue))
          (let ((cur (first queue)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (when (equal? cur goal-key) (set! found #t))
            (unless found
              (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d)))
                      (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                  (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                             (not (set-member? visited (cons nr nc)))
                             (or (= (at g nr nc) 0) (equal? (cons nr nc) goal-key)))
                    (set-add! visited (cons nr nc))
                    (hash-set! parent (cons nr nc) cur)
                    (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc)))))))))
          (bfs (+ step 1))))
      (if (not found)
          (list)
          (let trace ([cur goal-key] [acc (list)])
            (let ((next-acc (cons (list (car cur) (cdr cur)) acc)))
              (if (equal? cur (cons (first start) (second start)))
                  next-acc
                  (trace (hash-ref parent cur) next-acc))))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list colors)])
      (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
        (if (= (length pts) 2)
            (paint-cells out (path-cells (first pts) (second pts)) color)
            out)))))
